Instant structured triage uses transparent service rules. Optional on-device AI creates a full alternative job assessment. Nothing is sent to a cloud AI service.

Built as a portfolio project, using fictional examples. Custom or unrecognised sectors receive a general scoping brief; they do not receive specialist advice. Estimates need human review and are not binding offers.
